text: if you use Firefox you can't get past the sign up page as it won't go past the log in screen after you enter the 6 digit numbers they send you.. (Chrome works tho) also there is no way to quickly switch keyboards, so it breaks the useful feature that every other keyboard honours. (they allow you to hold down the space bar to enable hot keyboard switching.. this should be standard) 800 words is far too little to properly test over time. there should be a lifetime option as well ....
